paths.title: AI Video Academy
paths.tagline: Go from a blank prompt to a finished, publishable clip with Veo in the Gemini app
paths.description: A ladder from understanding what Veo 3.1 can and cannot do right now, through writing motion-first (and sound-first) prompts, planning multi-shot storyboards with ChatGPT, producing product and promo clips for social, iterating on flawed output, and finishing with a realistic production workflow that combines Veo clips with simple editing and a Claude-powered review pass. Built around Veo 3.1 in the Gemini app, today's rated all-round leader in AI video.
